questions.q: What is a configuration package in Functional Setup Manager?
options: A list of defect severities
An export of setup data scoped to an Implementation Project's task lists, used to move configuration between environments
A bank reconciliation report
A quarterly update readiness document
questions.explain: A configuration package exports setup data scoped to the relevant task lists so it can be imported into another environment instead of re-keyed.

questions.q: What is the standard discipline for where configuration should be built first?
options: Directly in Production, then copied downward
Independently and differently in every environment
In the lowest appropriate environment, then promoted upward toward Test and Production
Only inside the configuration workbook, never in Oracle itself
questions.explain: The standard practice is to configure once in a lower environment, then promote the same configuration package upward, guaranteeing Test and Production match.

questions.q: What does an incremental configuration package export contain?
options: Only the setup changes made since the last export
Every setup value in the entire Oracle Fusion instance
Only security roles and duty roles
Only data migration records
questions.explain: An incremental export contains only what has changed since the last configuration package export, rather than the full configuration.

questions.q: What is an example of a setup value that typically does NOT travel automatically with a configuration package?
options: A reconciliation matching rule's tolerance
A bank branch routing number
A task list name
An integration endpoint URL that differs per environment
questions.explain: Environment-specific values like integration endpoint URLs are deliberately excluded or require manual override after import, since they differ per environment.

questions.q: What did Brightfield's consultant check before importing the Cash Management configuration package into Test?
options: Nothing — packages are imported without review
The RAID log only
The comparison report, to confirm no one had manually changed settings directly in Test
The Executive Sponsor's calendar
questions.explain: The consultant reviewed FSM's comparison report against Test to catch any manual drift before importing the package.
